answers.core: I'd either have to rewrite the ItemList object to achieve this, or manually handle the list with a separate function, there is currently no manner to get ItemList to sort in any way other then based on the text itself.
answers.workaround: Not exactly, but its not hard to workaround, but I think this case I am forced to write inefficiently. While its not a large priority in any respect, I do think its better to give the capability to the developer on controling how the ItemList looks after its been created. (without resorting to manipulating the individual items bit by bit)

title: Add a custom sorting method to ItemList
